title: GEMSDOE68 — auto-context stacked refinement lane
description: DOE GEMS Prize Challenge lane (DrivenData competition 306) for auto-context stacked refinement of geothermal fault discovery: a two-stage pipeline whose stacked stage trains on the first stage's spatially blocked out-of-fold probability maps plus orientation-aware, multi-scale and catalogue-context features. Its README offers a one-click submission file (`gemsdoe68-autocontext-s2-20261012T014136Z-zeros.tif`, portal note “Auto-context physics 35707px … UNSCORED”, 35,707 predicted pixels, all finite and in [0,1]) and its project policy requires every number to be labelled HOLDOUT-DTI or ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED; the directory repeats the repository's own labels and validates no artifact. The configured Pages root has no index.html — the work is documented in README.md and docs/ — and GitHub Pages reports the build `errored` at this snapshot (see flags).
